name: Meditative Aphorite (Aphorite Variant)
source: Awesome Ancestries: Variant Species Options, Vol. 2 – Mortals of the Multiverse
book: Awesome Ancestries: Variant Species Options, Vol. 2 – Mortals of the Multiverse

facets.bk: Awesome Ancestries: Variant Species Options, Vol. 2 – Mortals of the Multiverse

body:
Among the aphorites, it is no secret that a subsect of them prefer a life of quiet contemplation. Less concerned about the order of the Multiverse, they tend to meditate more on questions of philosophy, and their own personal journey of knowledge and self-discipline.

Core Traits
Ability Scores You gain +2 Str, +2 Wis, –2 Cha. This alters ability score modifiers.
Alternate Species Traits
Combat Magic You can use true strike once per day as a spell-like ability, using your character level as the caster level. This trait alters spell-like ability.
Constructed Traits You are a first-generation aphorite, constructed directly by the axiomites of the Plane of Law, and your body is less organic than that of most of your kin. For the purposes of effects targeting creatures by type (such as a ranger’s favored enemy and bane weapons), you count both as an outsider and as a construct. You gain a +2 species bonus on all saving throws against mind-affecting effects, disease, poison, and sleep effects, unless those effects specifically target constructs. This trait replaces aphorite resistances and crystalline dust.
Specialized Study At 1st level, select any one Knowledge skill; once chosen, this selection cannot change. You gain a +2 species bonus with checks using your chosen Knowledge skill. This trait replaces skilled.
